## Independence and full inspected basis

Independent reviewer authored none of the engineering, tests, plan or Design. The complete actual M3 coordinator, CLI, YAML, setup/retry/evidence reader, docs, changed test and selector consumers were read with M1/M2 interactions. Current design-review-r4 and delivery-review-r1 normative package is unchanged; M2 code-review-m2-r2 is the predecessor approval, not approval of these new interactions. Original judgments remain intact. No engineering or activity/work edits were made by this reviewer.

The implemented positive path is substantive: exact-source preparation, complete candidate validation, one protected job, immutable retained ZIP binding, OIDC credential checks before public writes, Git CAS reporting, restored candidate/observation assets and current evidence-ref reading. Old tag-triggered publication is removed. Generated metadata and prior pending validators remain governed by existing owners. The real packed CLI integration uses actual produced tarball/archives and only substitutes public transports. Scope is M3, not final whole-change review or remote deployment.

## Proof and limitations

Author reports current frozen `python scripts/test-release-transaction.py` passed151 tests in116.012s at /tmp/release-m3-full.log. Earlier real-path15 tests passed59.893s. The first selector157 run had one failure because new coordinator was untracked; staging it resolved the existing path preflight and the named focused selector test passed0.10s, without an engineering correction. These observations do not close f1-f3.

Reviewer actual-main Python heredoc imported the CLI through runpy, invoked read-evidence dispatch with an external filesystem PermissionError and captured stderr plus step summary: both contained the private path and exit was1. No source was changed; this direct counterexample establishes the CLI defect. Complete-path test and workflow inspection establishes the stated proof gap; additional failures are not invented. The author independently disclosed missing optional final-evidence mirroring, which source inspection confirms.

## CI maintenance review

Applied code-review and ci-maintenance (review operation, GitHub Actions repository workflow, privileged-approved-design, CIM7 with coverage review). Concerns: triggers, permissions, required-check coverage and ordinary security hardening. Exact target is the workflow subject above. Default permissions are read-only; only the protected executor has contents/write and OIDC/write. No untrusted fork event, persisted checkout credentials, independent tag publisher or new remote configuration is selected. Global concurrency preserves active work; candidate uploads are immutable and observation uploads run after attempted execution. Toolchain setup and required commands are inspected by the parsed YAML validator; new source paths select the existing release-transaction proof. No new standalone CI architecture is required. The remaining requirements are the findings below, followed by current authoritative PR/Verify checks. Mutation outcome: none. Hosted CI observation: not-observed.

GitHub primary environment API documentation confirms environment reads use Actions/read, matching the declared jobs: https://docs.github.com/en/rest/deployments/environments#get-an-environment. This read-only API contract check does not assert actual remote protection/configuration.

| Compatibility | pass | Legacy tag bypass removed intentionally; historical evidence remains unchanged, new evidence-ref reader explicit. |
| Security/privacy | concern | Privilege separation and exact artifact binding sound; raw CLI errors violate confidentiality. |
| Derived artifact currency | concern | Real candidate and public companion chain checked; final optional evidence mirror absent. |
| Unrelated changes | pass | M3 source, workflow, docs and necessary test/selector amendments; no real publication or retirement. |
| Validation evidence | concern | Full151 pass is bounded local proof; allocated new boundary cases remain missing. |

## Handoff

Findings are recorded before corrections. Return to route for M3 correction and reassessment; this reviewer does not change lifecycle routing. No upstream policy decision is required for these bounded outcomes. M4, final whole-change Code Review, distinct Verify and optional PR remain. No hosted success, release success or final readiness is claimed.

## Finding release-m3-f1

- Finding ID: release-m3-f1
- Severity: minor
- Location: scripts/release-coordinator.py, main exception reporting
- Evidence: The new CLI catches OSError/ValueError and publishes str(exc) to stderr and GITHUB_STEP_SUMMARY, removing only one private diagnostic-log suffix. Independent actual-main invocation with an injected filesystem PermissionError(13, Permission denied, /private-worker/private-user/evidence) returned1 and included that private path in both outputs. Ordinary filesystem/provider/parser failures can therefore leak private worker paths or raw exception contents despite REL-SR-17.
- Required outcome: Use bounded safe operator errors and avoid raw exception serialization into public logs/summary. Preserve actionable failure class/operation and safe public identities without private paths or secrets; ensure failure while writing the summary cannot expose a secondary raw traceback. Exercise the actual CLI output boundary with filesystem/provider/subprocess failures and sensitive markers.
- Safe resolution path: bounded M3 implementation/proof correction followed by independent reassessment.
- needs-decision rationale: none; existing approved obligations select the outcome.

## Finding release-m3-f2

- Finding ID: release-m3-f2
- Severity: major
- Location: scripts/release_candidate_tests.py, ReleaseCandidateIntegrationTests and scripts/release_coordination_tests.py
- Evidence: The real-candidate integration calls prepare_operation/execute_operation for success, duplicate, successful candidate restoration and read/no-op. Lost publication response, failed public verification and failed evidence persistence remain executor-only M2 fixtures. The new retained observation artifact restore/reconcile path has no composed failure/recovery proof. The YAML invokes release-coordinator.py, but no test drives its main environment parsing, artifact digest normalization, GITHUB_OUTPUT/summary or failure exit boundary. TG-06 and the plan validation outcome explicitly allocate these actual coordinator/entry interactions; the confidentiality defect demonstrates why helper-only coverage is insufficient.
- Required outcome: Extend actual coordinator proof through the selected lost/partial, failed public verification and failed-reporting/restored-observation recovery paths. Preserve one approval, exact retained bytes, prior failure meaning and one write per confirmed boundary. Keep real candidate/build/package verification at least once and reuse the exact verified fixture basis for bounded negative composition where appropriate. Exercise actual CLI main/dispatch/environment/output/exit handling with only external services substituted; do not stub authorization, persistence or correctness validators.
- Safe resolution path: bounded M3 implementation/proof correction followed by independent reassessment.
- needs-decision rationale: none; existing approved obligations select the outcome.

## Finding release-m3-f3

- Finding ID: release-m3-f3
- Severity: minor
- Location: scripts/release_coordination.py, final evidence reporting integration
- Evidence: The reviewed runtime Design requires mirroring the final evidence bundle with release assets when possible, while durable repository evidence remains authority. Current execute_operation ends after execute_candidate and has no final-evidence mirror attempt or unavailable disposition. The author independently identified this outstanding M3 integration before correction; no mirror source edit exists in this reviewed snapshot.
- Required outcome: Complete the bounded best-effort mirror of the exact durable evidence basis, recording unavailable/conflict results separately from required publication correctness. Do not change candidate artifacts, overwrite existing different public evidence, introduce another approval, or make optional mirroring into publication authority. Prove exact mirrored identity and unavailable/conflicting mirror behavior through the coordinator.
- Safe resolution path: bounded M3 implementation/proof correction followed by independent reassessment.
- needs-decision rationale: none; existing approved obligations select the outcome.
